headline: A 2019 executive order took more steps under an existing national emergency about Venezuela, which serves as the legal basis for US sanctions.
what_it_does: This order builds on an earlier national emergency the US declared about Venezuela. Emergencies like this let the President use economic tools, such as sanctions, against certain people or groups. The title says the order takes "additional steps," but no summary was provided, so the exact changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may face expanded US economic restrictions, though the exact scope is not described in the available material.

who_it_affects.group: US companies and individuals doing business involving Venezuela
who_it_affects.how: They may need to follow additional US rules on transactions tied to Venezuela.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 25, 2019. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, but no effective date was given in the source material.
